    risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score' as rep,
    risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score' as trust,
    risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score' as impact,
    risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score' as cred,
    risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'authenticity_score' as auth
FROM risk_and_moderation 
WHERE risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score')::float ASC
LIMIT 10;

-- Try to extract all numeric values from risk_scores for each account and compute CV
WITH risk_vals AS (
    SELECT 
        acct_risk,
        jsonb_array_elements_text(
            jsonb_build_array(
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'authenticity_score'
            )
        ) as val
    FROM risk_and_moderation
)
SELECT 
    acct_risk,
    COUNT(*) as num_values,
    AVG(val::float) as avg_val,
    STDDEV(val::float) as stddev_val,
    CASE WHEN AVG(val::float) != 0 THEN STDDEV(val::float) / ABS(AVG(val::float)) ELSE NULL END as cv
FROM risk_vals
WHERE val IS NOT NULL AND val != 'None' AND val != 'null'
GROUP BY acct_risk
ORDER BY cv DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

-- Simple interpretation: lowest reputation score = wildest drop
SELECT 
    acct_risk,
    (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score')::float as rep_score
FROM risk_and_moderation 
WHERE risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score')::float ASC
LIMIT 3;

-- Compute RVI as CV * relative_rate_of_change for each account
-- Using all numeric sub-scores per account
WITH risk_vals AS (
    SELECT 
        acct_risk,
        jsonb_array_elements_text(
            jsonb_build_array(
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score',
                risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'authenticity_score'
            )
        ) as val
    FROM risk_and_moderation
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        acct_risk,
        AVG(val::float) as avg_val,
        STDDEV(val::float) as stddev_val,
        MAX(val::float) as max_val,
        MIN(val::float) as min_val,
        COUNT(*) as num_values
    FROM risk_vals
    WHERE val IS NOT NULL AND val != 'None' AND val != 'null'
    GROUP BY acct_risk
)
SELECT 
    acct_risk,
    avg_val,
    stddev_val,
    CASE WHEN avg_val != 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(stddev_val / ABS(avg_val) AS numeric), 4) END as cv,
    max_val - min_val as range,
    CASE WHEN avg_val != 0 THEN ROUND(CAST((max_val - min_val) / ABS(avg_val) AS numeric), 4) END as rel_range
FROM stats
ORDER BY cv DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

stats AS (

    FROM risk_vals

-- Compute per-account RVI based on cluster membership variance
WITH cluster_rep AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.acct_bridge,
        ca."CLSTR_PIN",
        (rm.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score')::float as rep_score
    FROM account_clusters ac
    JOIN risk_and_moderation rm ON ac.acct_bridge = rm.acct_risk
    JOIN cluster_analysis ca ON ac.clu_ref = ca."CLSTR_PIN"
    WHERE rm.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score' IS NOT NULL
),
cluster_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        "CLSTR_PIN",
        AVG(rep_score) as cluster_avg,
        STDDEV(rep_score) as cluster_stddev
    FROM cluster_rep
    GROUP BY "CLSTR_PIN"
)
SELECT 
    cr.acct_bridge,
    cr.rep_score,
    cs.cluster_avg,
    cs.cluster_stddev,
